summary: iter19 validation of admin-refactor + audit-log + sonner toasts + channel removal + ISO chat-cleanup. Backend pytest: 19 passed, 1 skipped (motor cross-loop limitation, covered by HTTP test). Frontend Playwright: admin dashboard loads, all 12 tabs render, all 7 representative tab-body data-testids present, audit-tab fully wired (search/filter chips/refresh/list), sonner toast confirmed firing on beta_mode toggle ('beta mode enabled'), CommunityPage chat tab shows EXACTLY 9 channels with show-off + news-and-events confirmed ABSENT, WebSocket connect to removed channels rejected with 4404. No critical bugs.

issues: Pre-existing React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' (not introduced this iteration; from a select/option markup elsewhere — non-blocking).

critical_code_review_comments: AdminDashboard.jsx slim orchestrator (182 lines) is clean — TABS array drives rendering, each tab component is lazy-imported but synchronously mounted; consider React.lazy + Suspense if bundle size becomes an issue.
AuditTab.jsx correctly uses useMemo for filter+search; reverse-chrono sort happens server-side (admin.py L686) — good. The `key={r.user_id}-${r.at}-${i}` is sufficient for React.

chat_cleanup._parse_iso correctly handles 'Z' suffix (replace with '+00:00'), tz-aware offsets, naive datetimes (assumes UTC), and invalid strings (returns None). All four parsing paths covered by unit tests.
/api/admin/audit-log uses async cursor iteration and excludes _id properly — good. Limit cap (default 200) protects against pathological data sizes.
Removed channels (show-off, news-and-events) are gone from BOTH backend CHANNELS set AND frontend CHANNELS list — confirmed parity. WS handshake rejects with 4404 close code as designed.
useModalA11y hook usage verified by code presence in BetaBanner, UsersTab, DigestsTab. Esc-close handlers wired via useEffect.
Sonner toast integration confirmed live: SettingsTab toggle fires 'beta mode enabled' / 'beta mode disabled' via toast.success — matches spec exactly.
Minor: AuditTab error fallback only shows generic 'Failed to load audit log' — could surface specific HTTP status for ops debugging.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on admin-refactor (12 tabs render), audit-log UI (all 7 testids), sonner toast verified live, 9 channels visible, 2 removed channels absent
